scripts.sync:backend: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('backend', 'api/backend', { recursive: true, filter: (src) => !src.includes('__pycache__') && !src.includes('.db') && !src.includes('temp') });"
scripts.build: npm run sync:backend && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('dist', '../dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('dist', '../public', { recursive: true });"
